changelog: - **A cash icon for real money.** The Icon field in the Inspector now offers Cash, a banknote, listed right after Game currency under Industry and life, so a model can tell real money from a game's own token at a glance. It behaves like the other sixteen: a drawing before the node's name that changes nothing a run computes, saved in the file and in share links under the same revision note, named in all 18 languages. A file that uses it opens in an older version with that mark left out and the node kept.
